verses.geez: አሌላ፡ ለአርኤል፡ ሀገር፡ እንተ፡ ጸብአ፡ ዳዊት።
verses.translation: Alas for the city Ariel, which David besieged. Gather ye fruits year by year; eat ye, for ye shall eat with Moab.

translations.lxx: Alas for the city Ariel, which David besieged. Gather ye fruits year by year; eat ye, for ye shall eat with Moab.
translations.kjv: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
translations.ron: Vai ţie, Ariele, Ariele, cetate în care a trăit David! Treacă an de an, şirul de praznice să se sfârşească!
translations.grk: Οὐαὶ Ἀριὴλ πόλις, ἣν ἐπολέμησε Δαυείδ· συναγάγετε γενήματα ἐνιαυτὸν ἐπὶ ἐνιαυτὸν, φάγεσθε, φάγεσθε γὰρ σὺν Μωάβ,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እሣቅዮ፡ ለአርኤል፡ ወትከውን፡ ዛቲ፡ ኃይል፡ ወዝንቱ፡ ብዕለ፡ ዚአየ።
verses.translation: For I will grievously afflict Ariel: and her strength and her wealth shall be mine.

translations.lxx: For I will grievously afflict Ariel: and her strength and her wealth shall be mine.
translations.kjv: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
translations.ron: Apoi voi împresura Arielul şi el va plânge şi va geme! Cetatea va fi ca un Ariel pentru Mine.
translations.grk: ἐκθλίψω γὰρ Ἀριήλ· καὶ ἔσται αὐτῆς ἡ ἰσχὺς καὶ ὁ πλοῦτος ἐμοί.

verses.geez: ወአዐግተኪ፡ ከመ፡ ዳዊት፡ ወአሐርጸኪ፡ ወእሠይም፡ ዐውደኪ፡ ማኅፈደ።
verses.translation: And I will compass thee about like David, and will raise a mound about thee, and set up towers round thee.

translations.lxx: And I will compass thee about like David, and will raise a mound about thee, and set up towers round thee.
translations.kjv: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.
translations.ron: Ca David voi tăbărî asupra ta, te voi înconjura cu valuri şi voi ridica întărituri împotriva ta.
translations.grk: Καὶ κυκλώσω ὡς Δαυὶδ ἐπὶ σὲ, καὶ βαλῶ περὶ σὲ χάρακα, καὶ θήσω περὶ σὲ πύργους,

verses.geez: ወይሠጠም፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ነገርኪ፡ ወይከውን፡ ቃልኪ፡ ከመ፡ ዘበታሕተ፡ ምድር፡ ይትናገር፤ ወትደክሚ፡ ወታቴሕቲ፡ ቃለኪ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: And thy words shall be brought down to the earth, and thy words shall sink down to the earth, and thy voice shall be as they that speak out of the earth, and thy voice shall be lowered to the ground.

translations.lxx: And thy words shall be brought down to the earth, and thy words shall sink down to the earth, and thy voice shall be as they that speak out of the earth, and thy voice shall be lowered to the ground.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.
translations.ron: Vei fi doborât la pământ şi de acolo se va auzi glasul tău; graiul tău din ţărână se va auzi; glasul tău va fi ca al unei năluci ce iese din pământ şi din praf spusele tale ca un murmur vor părea.
translations.grk: καὶ ταπεινωθήσονται εἰς τὴν γῆν οἱ λόγοι σου, καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν οἱ λόγοι σου δύσονται· καὶ ἔσονται ὡς οἱ φωνοῦντες ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἡ φωνή σου, καὶ πρὸς τὸ ἔδαφος ἡ φωνή σου ἀσθενήσει.

verses.geez: ወይከውን፡ ከመ፡ ጸበል፡ ዘእምአረፍት፡ ብዕሎሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ ወከመ፡ ንጉፍ፡ ዘያመጽኦ፡ ነፋስ፤ ወይከውን፡ በጊዜሃ፡ ለምዕር፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት።
verses.translation: But the wealth of the ungodly shall be as dust from a wheel, and the multitude of them that oppress thee as flying chaff, and it shall be suddenly as a moment,

translations.lxx: But the wealth of the ungodly shall be as dust from a wheel, and the multitude of them that oppress thee as flying chaff, and it shall be suddenly as a moment,
translations.kjv: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
translations.ron: Mulţimea vrăjmaşilor tăi va fi ca pulberea măruntă, ceata asupritorilor ca pleava care zboară. Dar aceasta se va petrece într-o clipă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ὡς κονιορτὸς ἀπὸ τροχοῦ ὁ πλοῦτος τῶν ἀσεβῶν, καὶ ὡς χνοῦς φερόμενος τὸ πλῆθος τῶν καταδυναστευόντων σε, καὶ ἔσται ὡς στιγμὴ παραχρῆμα

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ይዋሒ፡ በፀዓዕ፡ ወበድልቅልቅ፡ ወበዓቢይ፡ ቃል፡ ወበዐውሎ፡ ዘይመጽእ፡ ወበነበልባለ፡ እሳት፡ በላዒ።
verses.translation: from the Lord of hosts: for there shall be a visitation with thunder, and earthquake, and a loud noise, a rushing tempest, and devouring flame of fire.

translations.lxx: from the Lord of hosts: for there shall be a visitation with thunder, and earthquake, and a loud noise, a rushing tempest, and devouring flame of fire.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
translations.ron: Domnul Savaot te va cerceta cu tunet, cutremur şi zgomot mare, uragan şi vijelie şi flăcări de foc mistuitor!
translations.grk: παρὰ Κυρίου σαβαώθ· ἐπισκοπὴ γὰρ ἔσται μετὰ βροντῆς καὶ σεισμοῦ καὶ φωνὴς μεγάλης, καταιγὶς φερομένη, καὶ φλὸξ πυρὸς κατεσθίουσα.

verses.geez: ወይከውን፡ ብዕሎሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ከመ፡ ዘየሐልም፡ ሕልመ፣፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ይጸብእዎሙ፡ ለእስራኤል፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ይጸብእዋ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ተጋብኡ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ወሮድዋ።
verses.translation: And the wealth of all the nations together, as many as have fought against Ariel, and all they that war against Jerusalem, and all who are gathered against her, and they that distress her, shall be as one that dreams in sleep by night.

translations.lxx: And the wealth of all the nations together, as many as have fought against Ariel, and all they that war against Jerusalem, and all who are gathered against her, and they that distress her, shall be as one that dreams in sleep by night.
translations.kjv: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
translations.ron: Şi ca un vis, ca o vedenie de noapte va fi mulţimea de popoare luptătoare împotriva lui Ariel, care se vor război cu el, cu cetatea lui şi de jur împrejur o vor strânge.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἐνυπνιαζόμενος καθʼ ὕπνους νυκτὸς, ὁ πλοῦτος ἁπάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν, ὅσοι ἐπεστράτευσαν ἐπὶ Ἀριὴλ, καὶ πάντες οἱ στρατευόμενοι ἐπὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ, καὶ πάντες οἱ συνηγμένοι ἐπʼ αὐτὴν, καὶ οἱ θλίβοντες αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ወይከውኑ፡ ከመ፡ እለ፡ ይበልዑ፡ ወይሰትዩ፡ በሕልሞሙ፣፡ ወሶበ፡ ይነቅሁ፡ ይሔስዎሙ፡ ሕልሞሙ፤ ወበከመ፡ ጽሙእ፡ ዘየሐልም፡ እንዘ፡ ይሰቲ፡ ማየ፣፡ ወነቂሆ፡ ዓዲሃ፡ ጽምእት፡ ነፍሱ፡ ወከንቶ፡ ተሰፈወ፤ ከማሁ፡ ውእቱ፡ ብዕሎሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ አሕዛብ፡ እለ፡ ጸብእዎ፡ ለደብረ፡ ጽዮን።
verses.translation: And as men drink and eat in sleep, and when they have arisen, the dream is vain: and as a thirsty man dreams as if he drank, and having arisen is still thirsty, and his soul has desired in vain: so shall be the wealth of all the nations, as many as have fought against the mount Sion.

translations.lxx: And as men drink and eat in sleep, and when they have arisen, the dream is vain: and as a thirsty man dreams as if he drank, and having arisen is still thirsty, and his soul has desired in vain: so shall be the wealth of all the nations, as many as have fought against the mount Sion.
translations.kjv: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
translations.ron: După cum cel flămând visează că mănâncă şi se trezeşte tot cu stomacul gol, şi după cum cel însetat visează că bea şi se trezeşte istovit şi tot însetat, tot aşa se va întâmpla cu mulţimea de popoare care vor merge împotriva muntelui Sion!
translations.grk: Καὶ ὡς οἱ ἐν τῷ ὕπνῳ πίνοντες καὶ ἔσθοντες, καὶ ἐξαναστάντων, μάταιον τὸ ἐνύπνιον· καὶ ὃν τρόπον ἐνυπνιάζεται ὁ διψῶν ὡς ὁ πίνων, καὶ ἐξαναστὰς ἔτι διψᾷ, ἡ δὲ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ εἰς κενὸν ἤλπισεν· οὕτως ἔσται ὁ πλοῦτος τῶν ἐθνῶν πάντων, ὅσοι ἐπεστράτευσαν ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος Σιών.

verses.geez: ደክሙ፡ ወደንገፁ፡ ወሰክሩ፡ አኮ፡ በሜስ፡ ወአኮ፡ በወይን።
verses.translation: Faint ye, and be amazed, and be overpowered, not with strong drink nor with wine.

translations.lxx: Faint ye, and be amazed, and be overpowered, not with strong drink nor with wine.
translations.kjv: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
translations.ron: Staţi încremeniţi şi înmărmuriţi, fiţi orbi şi orbi rămâneţi! Îmbătaţi-vă, dar nu de vin; clătinaţi-vă, dar nu de băutură!
translations.grk: Ἐκλύθητε καὶ ἔκστητε, καὶ κραιπαλήσατε οὐκ ἀπὸ σίκερα οὐδὲ ἀπὸ οἴνου.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አስተዮሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጋኔነ፡ ዘያደነግፆሙ፡ ወይከድኖሙ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ፡ ለነቢያቲሆሙ፡ ወለመላእክቲሆሙ፡ እለ፡ ይሬእዩ፡ ዘኅቡእ።
verses.translation: For the Lord has made you to drink a spirit of deep sleep; and he shall close their eyes, and the eyes of their prophets and of their rulers, who see secret things.

translations.lxx: For the Lord has made you to drink a spirit of deep sleep; and he shall close their eyes, and the eyes of their prophets and of their rulers, who see secret things.
translations.kjv: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
translations.ron: Că Domnul a turnat peste voi un duh de toropeală. El a închis ochii voştri, profeţilor, şi capetele voastre, văzătorilor, le-a acoperit cu văl.
translations.grk: ὅτι πεπότικεν ὑμᾶς Κύριος πνεύματι κατανύξεως, καὶ καμμύσει τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν, καὶ τῶν προφητῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων αὐτῶν, οἱ ὁρῶντες τὰ κρυπτά.

verses.geez: ወይከውነክሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ነገር፡ ከመ፡ ነገረ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ኅቱም፤ ወይሁብዎ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ዘየአምር፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ወይብልዎ፤ አንብብ፡ ዘንተ።
verses.translation: And all these things shall be to you as the words of this sealed book, which if they shall give to a learned man, saying, Read this, he shall then say, I cannot read it, for it is sealed.

translations.lxx: And all these things shall be to you as the words of this sealed book, which if they shall give to a learned man, saying, Read this, he shall then say, I cannot read it, for it is sealed.
translations.kjv: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:
translations.ron: Drept aceea orice descoperire este pentru voi ca graiurile dintr-o carte pecetluită. Dacă le dai cuiva care ştie carte şi-i zici: "Citeşte!" el iţi răspunde: "Nu pot, căci ea este pecetluită!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν τὰ ῥήματα πάντα ταῦτα, ὡς οἱ λόγοι τοῦ βιβλίου τοῦ ἐσφραγισμένου τσύτου, ὃ ἐὰν δῶσιν αὐτὸ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐπισταμένῳ γράμματα, λέγοντες, ἀνάγνωθι ταῦτα· καὶ ἐρεῖ, οὐ δύναμαι ἀναγνῶναι, ἐσφράγισται γάρ.

verses.geez: ወይሁብዎ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ዘኢየአምር፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ወይብልዎ፤ አንብብ፡ ዘንተ።
verses.translation: And this book shall be given into the hands of a man that is unlearned, and one shall say to him, Read this; and he shall say, I am not learned.

translations.lxx: And this book shall be given into the hands of a man that is unlearned, and one shall say to him, Read this; and he shall say, I am not learned.
translations.kjv: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.
translations.ron: Şi dacă o dai cuiva care nu ştie carte şi-i zici: "Citeşte!", el îţi va răspunde: "Nu ştiu carte!"
translations.grk: καὶ δοθήσεται τὸ βιβλίον τοῦτο εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπου μὴ ἐπισταμένου γράμματα, καὶ ἐρεῖ αὐτῷ, ἀνάγνωθι τοῦτο· καὶ ἐρεῖ, οὐκ ἐπίσταμαι γράμματα.

verses.geez: ወይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ ዝንቱ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ይቀርቡኒ፡ በአፉሆሙ፡ ወበከናፍሪሆሙ፡ ያከብሩኒ፣፡ ወበልቦሙሰ፡ ነዋኃ፡ ይርኅቁ፡ እምኔየ።
verses.translation: And the Lord has said, This people draw nigh to me with their mouth, and they honour me with their lips, but their heart is far from me: but in vain do they worship me, teaching the commandments and doctrines of men.

translations.lxx: And the Lord has said, This people draw nigh to me with their mouth, and they honour me with their lips, but their heart is far from me: but in vain do they worship me, teaching the commandments and doctrines of men.
translations.kjv: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
translations.ron: Şi a zis Domnul: "De aceea poporul acesta se apropie de Mine cu gura şi cu buzele Mă cinsteşte, dar cu inima este departe, căci închinarea înaintea Mea nu este decât o rânduială omenească învăţată de la oameni.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος, ἐγγίζει μοι ὁ λαὸς οὗτος ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν τοῖς χείλεσιν αὐτῶν τιμῶσί με, ἡ δὲ καρδία αὐτῶν πόῤῥω ἀπέχει ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ· μάτην δὲ σέβονταί με, διδάσκοντες ἐντάλματα ἀνθρώπων καὶ διδασκαλίας.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ናሁ፡ እደግም፡ አፍልሶቶ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሕዝብ፣፡ ወአፈልሶሙ፡ ወአሐጕሎሙ፡ ጥበቦሙ፡ ለጠቢባን፡ ወአኀብኦሙ፡ ምክሮሙ፡ ለመካርያን።
verses.translation: Therefore behold I will proceed to remove this people, and I will remove them: and I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will hide the understanding of the prudent.

translations.lxx: Therefore behold I will proceed to remove this people, and I will remove them: and I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will hide the understanding of the prudent.
translations.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
translations.ron: De aceea voi face pentru poporul acesta minuni fără seamăn. Înţelepciunea celor înţelepţi se va pierde şi isteţimea celor isteţi va pieri.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο ἰδοὺ προσθήσω τοῦ μεταθεῖναι τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον, καὶ μεταθήσω αὐτούς, καὶ ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν, καὶ τὴν σύνεσιν τῶν συνετῶν κρύψω.

verses.geez: አሌ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይመክሩ፡ ዕሙቀ፡ ምክረ፡ ወአኮ፡ በበይነ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Woe to them that deepen their counsel, and not by the Lord. Woe to them that take secret counsel, and whose works are in darkness, and they say, Who has seen us? and who shall know us, or what we do?

translations.lxx: Woe to them that deepen their counsel, and not by the Lord. Woe to them that take secret counsel, and whose works are in darkness, and they say, Who has seen us? and who shall know us, or what we do?
translations.kjv: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
translations.ron: Vai de cei ce ascund lui Dumnezeu taina planurilor lor, ca faptele lor să se facă la întuneric! Vai de cei care zic: "Cine ne vede? Cine ne ştie?"
translations.grk: Οὐαὶ οἱ βαθέως βουλὴν ποιοῦντες, καὶ οὐ διὰ Κυπίυο· οὐαὶ οἱ ἐν κρυφῇ βουλὴν ποιοῦντες, καὶ ἔσται ἐν σκότει τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐροῦσι, τίς ἑόρακεν ἡμᾶς; καὶ τίς ἡμᾶς γνώσεται, ἢ ἃ ἡμεῖς ποιοῦμεν;

verses.geez: አኮኑ፡ ከመ፡ ጽቡረ፡ ለብሐዊ፡ አንትሙ፤ ይብሎኑ፡ ኪን፡ ለኬንያሁ፤ ኢገበርከነ፡ አንተ፤ ወይብሎኑ፡ ግብር፡ ለገባሪሁ፤ ኢያሠነይከኒ፡ ገቢሮትየ።
verses.translation: Shall ye not be counted as clay of the potter? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Thou didst not form me? or the work to the maker, Thou hast not made me wisely?

translations.lxx: Shall ye not be counted as clay of the potter? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Thou didst not form me? or the work to the maker, Thou hast not made me wisely?
translations.kjv: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
translations.ron: Ce stricăciune! Oare olarul poate fi socotit drept lut? Lucrul poate oare zice despre lucrător: "Nu m-a făcut el!" Vasul zice oare despre olar: "El nu pricepe?"
translations.grk: Οὐχ ὡς πηλὸς τοῦ κεραμέως λογισθήσεσθε; μὴ ἐρεῖ τὸ πλάσμα τῷ πλάσαντι αὐτό, οὐ σύ με ἔπλασας; ἢ τὸ ποίημα τῷ ποιήσαντι, οὐ συνετῶς με ἐποίησας;

verses.geez: አኮኑ፡ እንከ፡ ኅዳጠ፡ ወእምዝ፡ ይከውን፡ ሊባኖስ፡ ከመ፡ ደብረ፡ ከርሜል፡ ወይከውን፡ ከርሜል፡ ከመ፡ ዖም።
verses.translation: Is it not yet a little while, and Libanus shall be changed as the mountain of Chermel, and Chermel shall be reckoned as a forest?

translations.lxx: Is it not yet a little while, and Libanus shall be changed as the mountain of Chermel, and Chermel shall be reckoned as a forest?
translations.kjv: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
translations.ron: Încă puţină vreme şi Libanul se va schimba în grădină, şi grădina va fi socotită pădure.
translations.grk: Οὐκέτι μικρὸν καὶ μετατεθήσεται ὁ Λίβανος, ὡς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Χέρμελ, καὶ τὸ Χέρμελ εἰς δρυμὸν λογισθήσεται;

verses.geez: ወውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ይሰምዑ፡ ጽሙማን፡ ቃለ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ወእለሂ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽልመት፡ ወእለሂ፡ ውስተ፡ ጊሜ።
verses.translation: And in that day the deaf shall hear the words of the book, and they that are in darkness, and they that are in mist: the eyes of the blind shall see,

translations.lxx: And in that day the deaf shall hear the words of the book, and they that are in darkness, and they that are in mist: the eyes of the blind shall see,
translations.kjv: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
translations.ron: În vremea aceea, cei surzi vor auzi cuvintele cărţii şi ochii celor orbi vor vedea fără umbră şi fără întuneric.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀκούσονται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ κωφοὶ λόγους βιβλίου, καὶ οἱ ἐν τῷ σκότει, καὶ οἱ ἐν τῇ ὁμίχλῃ· ὀφθαλμοὶ τυφλῶν ὄψονται,

verses.geez: ወይትፌሥሑ፡ ነዳያን፡ በእግዚአብሔር፡ በኃሤት፡ ወይጸግቡ፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ቅቡጻን፡ በቅዱሰ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: and the poor shall rejoice with joy because of the Lord, and they that had no hope among men shall be filled with joy.

translations.lxx: and the poor shall rejoice with joy because of the Lord, and they that had no hope among men shall be filled with joy.
translations.kjv: The meek also shall increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
translations.ron: Cei smeriţi se vor bucura întru Domnul şi cei săraci se vor veseli de Sfântul lui Israel.
translations.grk: καὶ ἀγαλλιάσονται πτωχοὶ διὰ Κύριον ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ, καὶ οἱ ἀπηλπισμένοι τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐμπλησθήσονται εὐφροσύνης.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኀልቀ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ወጠፍአ፡ ዕቡይ፡ ወተሠርዉ፡ እለ፡ ይዔምፁ፡ በእከይ።
verses.translation: The lawless man has come to nought, and the proud man has perished, and they that transgress mischievously have been utterly destroyed:

translations.lxx: The lawless man has come to nought, and the proud man has perished, and they that transgress mischievously have been utterly destroyed:
translations.kjv: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
translations.ron: Că apăsătorul nu va mai fi, cel batjocoritor va pieri, distruşi vor fi cei ce pândeau să facă rău,
translations.grk: Ἐξέλιπεν ἄνομος, καὶ ἀπώλετο ὑπερήφανος, καὶ ἐξωλοθρεύθησαν οἱ ἀνομοῦντες ἐπὶ κακίᾳ,

verses.geez: ወአለ፡ ያስሕቱ፡ ሰብአ፡ በነገር፤ ወኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ይትዋቀሡ፡ በኀበ፡ አናቅጽ፡ ያመጽኡ፡ ማዕቅፍተ፡ ወጠወይዎ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ በዓመፃሆሙ።
verses.translation: and they that cause men to sin by a word: and men shall make all that reprove in the gates an offence, because they have unjustly turned aside the righteous.

translations.lxx: and they that cause men to sin by a word: and men shall make all that reprove in the gates an offence, because they have unjustly turned aside the righteous.
translations.kjv: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
translations.ron: Cei care găseau vină oricui, pentru un cuvânt în faţa lumii întind cursă judecătorului şi pentru nimic răpesc dreptul celui cinstit.
translations.grk: καὶ οἱ ποιοῦντες ἁμαρτεῖν ἀνθρώπους ἐν λόγῳ· πάντας δὲ τοὺς ἐλέγχοντας ἐν πύλαις πρόσκομμα θήσουσιν, ὅτι ἐπλαγίασαν ἐπʼ ἀδίκοις δίκαιον.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለቤተ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ዘአውፅኦ፡ እምቤተ፡ አብርሃም፤ አኮ፡ ይእዜ፡ ዘተፍር፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ወአኮ፡ ይእዜ፡ ዘይትዌለጥ፡ ገጽከ።
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the house of Jacob, whom he set apart from Abraam, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall he now change countenance.

translations.lxx: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the house of Jacob, whom he set apart from Abraam, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall he now change countenance.
translations.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
translations.ron: Pentru aceasta, Domnul, Care a răscumpărat pe Avraam aşa zice către casa lui Iacov: "De aici încolo, nu se va mai ruşina Iacov şi faţa lui nu se va mai îngălbeni.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰακώβ, ὃν ἀφώρισεν ἐξ Ἀβραὰμ, οὐ νῦν αἰσχυνθήσεται Ἰακώβ, οὐδὲ νῦν τὸ πρόσωπον μεταβαλεῖ.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ርእዩ፡ ደቂቆሙ፡ ምግባርየ፣፡ በእንቲአየ፡ ይቄድሱ፡ ስምየ፡ ወይቄድሱ፡ ቤተ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ወለአምላከ፡ እስራኤልሂ፡ ይፈርህዎ።
verses.translation: But when their children shall have seen my works, they shall sanctify my name for my sake, and they shall sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

translations.lxx: But when their children shall have seen my works, they shall sanctify my name for my sake, and they shall sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
translations.kjv: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
translations.ron: Şi atunci când vor vedea lucrul mâinilor Mele în mijlocul lor, sfinţi-vor numele Meu, vor chema sfânt pe Sfântul lui Iacov şi se vor teme de Dumnezeul lui Israel.
translations.grk: Ἀλλʼ ὅταν ἴδωσιν τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν τὰ ἔργα μου, διʼ ἐμὲ ἁγιάσουσι τὸ ὄνομά μου, καὶ ἁγιάσουσι τὸν ἅγιον Ἰακὼβ, καὶ τὸν Θεὸν τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ φοβηθήσονται.

verses.geez: ወየአምሩ፡ ጥበበ፡ እለ፡ ስህቱ፡ በመንፈሶሙ፡ ወእለሂ፡ ያንጐረጕሩ፡ ይትሜሀሩ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ወይትሜሀር፡ አውሥኦ፡ ሰላም፡ ልሳን፡ ጸያፍ።
verses.translation: And they that erred in spirit shall know understanding, and the murmurers shall learn obedience, and the stammering tongues shall learn to speak peace.

translations.lxx: And they that erred in spirit shall know understanding, and the murmurers shall learn obedience, and the stammering tongues shall learn to speak peace.
translations.kjv: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
translations.ron: Cei rătăciţi cu duhul vor căpăta înţelepciune şi cei cârtitori învăţătură".
translations.grk: Καὶ γνώσονται οἱ πλανώμενοι τῷ πνεύματι σύνεσιν, οἱ δὲ γογγύζοντες μαθήσονται ὑπακούειν, καὶ αἱ γλῶσσαι αἱ ψελλίζουσαι μαθήσονται λαλεῖν εἰρήνην.
